build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with two dynamic balls and static bars using creator_lib
create_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls positioned at parameterized x coordinates with fixed height
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the scene with configurable scale angle and position
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two balls to be touching using SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier TWO_BALLS for two-ball puzzle classification
